slides.title: The Power of a Good Prompt
content: A weak prompt gets a weak answer.
A great prompt gets a great answer.
slides.narration:
Have you ever got a strange answer from an AI?
That's because of a weak prompt.
A weak prompt gets a weak answer.
But a great prompt gets a smart answer.
So, let's learn to write great prompts.
slides.image_prompt: Split screen: Left side shows a frustrated person looking at a screen with a generic, unhelpful AI response. Right side shows a happy person looking at a screen with a detailed, helpful AI response.

slides.title: Introducing the 3 Cs
content: Clarity
Context
Constraints
slides.narration:
The best prompts almost always include three key ingredients.
We call them the 3 Cs.
They are Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Let's explore each one in detail now.
slides.image_prompt: An infographic showing three interconnected circles or blocks labeled 'Clarity', 'Context', and 'Constraints'. A central arrow points to 'Excellent Prompt'.

slides.title: C1: Clarity - Be Specific!
content: The AI doesn't know what you're thinking.
Vague prompts lead to generic, unhelpful answers.
slides.narration:
First, let's start with Clarity.
It means being very specific.
The AI can't read your mind.
Vague prompts give generic answers.
They are often unhelpful.
So, be clear!
slides.image_prompt: A magnifying glass focusing on the word 'Clarity' amidst blurred text. A thought bubble above an AI robot head shows confused question marks.

slides.title: Clarity Example: Electric Cars
content: Weak Prompt: "Write about electric cars."
Clear Prompt: "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Here's a weak prompt: "Write about electric cars."
It's too broad.
Now, look at this clear prompt.
It asks for a short blog post.
It specifies the top 3 benefits.
And it's for someone in a city.
See the difference in specificity?
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison. Left: A text box labeled 'Weak Prompt' with 'Write about electric cars.' Inside. Right: A text box labeled 'Clear Prompt' with 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.' Inside.

slides.title: C2: Context - Give Background!
content: Context tells the AI why you're asking.
It helps the AI adopt the right perspective.
slides.narration:
Now, let's move to Context.
Context gives the AI background information.
It tells the AI why you're asking.
It also clarifies who the audience is.
This helps the AI adopt the right perspective.
It's like setting the scene.
slides.image_prompt: An AI robot icon with a thought bubble filling with various background details (e.g., audience icons, purpose symbols). A lightbulb appears above its head.

slides.title: Context Example: Lifestyle Blog
content: Good Prompt: "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
Better Prompt (with Context): "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Let's take our clear prompt.
It's a good prompt already.
Now, let's add context to it.
We'll specify it's for a lifestyle blog.
And it focuses on sustainable living.
This gives the AI a specific angle.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison. Left: A text box labeled 'Good Prompt' with the previous clear prompt. Right: A text box labeled 'Better Prompt (with Context)' with the new prompt including the lifestyle blog context.

slides.title: C3: Constraints - Set Rules!
content: Constraints are boundaries that shape the output.
Tell the AI the length, format, and style you need.
slides.narration:
Finally, let's talk about Constraints.
These are rules you set for the AI.
They act as boundaries.
Tell the AI the length you need.
Specify the desired format.
Also, define the style you want.
Constraints shape the AI's response precisely.
slides.image_prompt: An image of a ruler, a checklist, and a clock icon surrounding the word 'Constraints', symbolizing rules, format, and length.

slides.title: Constraints Example: Blog Post Rules
content: Better Prompt: "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."

Excellent Prompt (with Constraints): "Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments."
slides.narration:
We have our better prompt.
Now, let's add some constraints.
We'll limit it to under 400 words.
We'll ask for a friendly, enthusiastic tone.
And it should end with a question.
This makes our prompt excellent.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison. Left: A text box labeled 'Better Prompt' with the previous prompt including context. Right: A text box labeled 'Excellent Prompt (with Constraints)' with the new prompt including length, tone, and ending constraints.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
content: Tell the AI who to be.
This is a super-powerful trick.
slides.narration:
Here's a bonus tip.
It's really powerful.
Tell the AI who to be.
This is called providing a Persona.
It helps the AI adopt a specific role.
Think about it.
slides.image_prompt: An illustration of a person's silhouette with multiple thought bubbles showing different professional hats (e.g., chef hat, doctor's stethoscope, teacher's glasses).

slides.title: Persona Example: Expert Travel Agent
content: Prompt: "Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food."
slides.narration:
Look at this example prompt.
We ask the AI to "Act as an expert travel agent."
And we specify "specializing in budget travel."
Then, we give the task.
This ensures the AI thinks like an expert.
It helps a lot.
slides.image_prompt: An illustration of a travel agent character (e.g., wearing a uniform, holding a map) with a thought bubble showing a stylized itinerary for Rome.

slides.title: Recap: The 3 Cs + Persona
content: Clarity: Be Specific!
Context: Give Background!
Constraints: Set Rules!
Persona: Tell AI who to be!
slides.narration:
So, to write excellent prompts.
Remember the 3 Cs.
Clarity for specificity.
Context for background.
Constraints for rules.
And don't forget the Persona.
These tools will transform your AI outputs.

slides.title: Assignment
content: Choose a topic you're interested in.
Write a prompt using all 3 Cs (Clarity, Context, Constraints).
Add a specific Persona to your prompt.
Try your prompt in an AI chatbot and observe the results.
slides.narration:
Now, here's an assignment for you.
Choose a topic that you like.
Write a prompt using all 3 Cs.
Add a specific Persona too.
Then, try it in your favorite AI chatbot.
See the difference yourself.
